json.description: 6 BR | 4.5 BA |  3,700–3,900 SF |  3.8–4.0 Acres | Built 2005  Welcome to your everyday retreat. Set far off the road on nearly four peaceful acres, this home invites slow mornings and easy evenings. Start the day on the patio with coffee as the sky warms, and wind down at golden hour with a glass of wine while the sun sets over the trees. There’s room here to breathe, to host, to grow.  Inside, generous living and dining spaces flow around a central kitchen—perfect for weeknight dinners, weekend brunch, and impromptu gatherings that spill outside. With six bedrooms and 4.5 baths, you’ll have total flexibility for guests, multi-generational living, or a quiet office tucked away from the action.  Outside is where the magic keeps happening:  Carve out raised garden beds for herbs, tomatoes, and cut flowers—steps from the kitchen.  Set a long farm table on the patio for al-fresco dinners under the string lights.  Add a fire pit for s’mores nights, stargazing, and crisp-weather conversations.  Let kids (and pups) run free with room for a play set, soccer goals, or a future sport court.  Create a mini orchard, pollinator garden, or simply enjoy the privacy and birdsong.  Practical perks tie it all together—2005 construction, abundant parking, great storage, and quick access to 695/70, shopping, and dining—so you get sanctuary without sacrificing convenience.  Why you’ll love living here  Sunrise coffees + sunset dinners on the patio  Space for serious gardening and outdoor living  Flexible bedroom count for guests, hobbies, or WFH  A private, quiet setting that still keeps you close to everything
